name: Houou Senki Maimu
source:
"It's the usual way home from the club after school, but something was not right... Kenta tried to shake that feeling off his chest and hurried home. All of the sudden, the bright moonlight faded and Kenta looked up just to see a figure of a person floating in the air. The figure became bigger and bigger... then he realized that it was falling toward him! Not only that but it was a girl in torn up kimono!

Kenta rescued the falling person in time and discovered that her face was covered with a Prajna mask.

'My name is Maimu...'
'You are the chosen person... the person that will fight along with me...'

Then a man and a woman wearing a black kimono appeared and began attack them! Suddenly, the Prajna mask and Kenta's body glowed before the mask split. Then his body was absorbed into the 'Homura armor' that is being armed to Maimu who stood up and now radiated dazzling light.

'The evil doers are purged as Bird of Flame rises. The warrior of love and courage, Houou Senki☆Maimu has arrived!'

Maimu is actually a princess warrior who came to prevent Heike army from conquering the Earth. The story about a protagonist and a heroine that came from a faraway world in order to stop the world invasion has begun."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=202901]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
"这本该只是和平日一样的放学归途，可总觉得哪里不对…健太试图甩开这种不安，加快脚步回家。突然，明亮的月光暗了下来。健太抬头望去，只见一个人影漂浮在空中。那身影越来越大…他这才发现，对方正朝自己坠落！而且，那还是一个身穿破烂和服的女孩！

健太及时接住了坠落之人，发现她脸上戴着般若面具。

'我叫舞梦…'
'你就是被选中的人…将与我并肩战斗之人…'

随后，一男一女两个身穿黑色和服的人现身，开始攻击他们！突然，般若面具与健太的身体同时发光，面具随之裂开。紧接着，他的身体被吸入了装备在舞梦身上的'焰之铠甲'。舞梦站起身来，浑身散发出耀眼光芒。

'火焰之鸟展翅之时，邪恶之徒皆受净化。爱与勇气的战士，凤凰战姬☆舞梦，登场！'

舞梦其实是一名战士公主，来到这里是为了阻止平家军征服地球。主人公与来自遥远世界的女主角为阻止世界遭受侵略而战的故事，就此开始。"

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=202901]Getchu[/url]]
